content.text: morning. before anything else — the archive goes on the slow disk from now on, the fast one is scratch only. I don't want to argue about it again.
and we are NOT going to add a second index. I know it looks tempting. one index, always.
understood. one index. I'll note the disk split too.
run the throughput test on the new build please
throughput 43.7 tok/s (was 12.4 tok/s before the fan install)
43.7, good. that's the number to quote. anything above 40 means the fans did their job.
weather's nice today isn't it. anyway.
careful with the cp932 boundary — crossing it silently produces zero rows and no error at all. it has bitten us three times.
one exception on the disk rule: anything under 1GB can live on the fast disk, it isn't worth the round trip.
noted: slow disk by default, under 1GB may stay on fast.
actually, scratch what I said this morning about the archive. put it on the NAS instead — the slow disk is going to be reformatted next week.
the fan thing again — I keep coming back to it. we should measure the DIMM side too, not just the GPU side.
the repo is at github.com/example/thing and the port is in the config file, you can look those up
